headline: Barefoot in a Saree: Mother Passes Jharkhand Guard Test
meta_description: After losing her husband, Kavita trained in her saree on early morning runs and passed the Jharkhand Home Guard physical test with time to spare.
summary_short: Widowed mother Kavita ran 1,600 metres barefoot in six minutes—four minutes under the qualifying time—without shoes, gear, or formal training.
body:
Kavita completed 1,600 metres in six minutes, four minutes faster than the required time for the Jharkhand Home Guard physical test—and she did it barefoot, in her saree, with no professional equipment.

Since her husband's death, Kavita has been the sole provider for her two young children and elderly in-laws. Unable to afford running shoes, a tracksuit, or coaching, she trained herself. Every morning at 4 a.m., she practised on the roads in her saree, preparing for this single opportunity to secure stable work and support her family.

Her success is not about exceptional talent but remarkable determination. With nothing but early mornings and resolve, Kavita cleared a test designed for trained recruits. On Monday, her preparation paid off.
quick_facts: Ran 1,600 metres in six minutes, barefoot, in a saree
Qualified time was 10 minutes; she finished in six
Widowed mother supporting two children and elderly in-laws alone
Trained at 4 a.m. daily on roads without professional gear
Passed Jharkhand Home Guard recruitment physical test
